title: ASW<SUP>2</SUP>DF: Census of the obscured star formation in a galaxy cluster in formation at z = 2.2
question: Census of dust-obscured star-forming galaxies in the Spiderweb protocluster: ALMA 1.2 mm number counts, overdensity, spatial distribution relative to HAEs and CO emitters, and single-dish multiplicity

data.bands: Band 6 (1.2 mm), six contiguous fields, each an 87-pointing mosaic covering 1' x 3'
data.sensitivity: 1 sigma rms 40.3-57.1 uJy across the six fields

what.value: HAE catalogue and density map method

evidence.quote: The adopted method and the constructed HAE density map are identical to those of (cite: Shimakawa2018b).

what.value: CO(1-0) emitter catalogue with alpha_CO assignment per source

evidence.quote: Following (cite: Jin2021), we assign different $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ values for each source individually

what.value: Average ALESS SED used for flux conversion between wavelengths and to 850 um for SFRs

evidence.quote: We adopt an average spectral energy distribution from a sample of ALESS SMGs (cite: da_Cunha2015), and assume a redshift of 2.2

what.value: General-field cumulative number counts used as the baseline for overdensity

evidence.loc: 5.1 Overdensity of DSFGs detected by ALMA
evidence.quote: We adopt the recent results from the ALMACAL (cite: Chen2023a) and GOODS-ALMA (cite: Franco2018; Gomez2022) surveys

what.value: General-field best-fitting curve for ADF22/SSA22-style overdensity comparison

evidence.loc: 5.1 Overdensity of DSFGs detected by ALMA
evidence.quote: We compare our number counts with the fitting curve of general fields given in (cite: Umehata2018)

evidence.loc: 5.1 Overdensity of DSFGs detected by ALMA
evidence.quote: reported 16 SMGs detected by APEX LABOCA
then derive the SFR for each source based on the linear relation from (cite: Cowie2017)

what.value: Average cosmic SFR density for comparison

evidence.quote: being around 14 times that of the average cosmic SFR density (cite: Madau2014)

recipe.goal: calibrate and image the six mosaics in continuum
recipe.method: ALMA pipeline/archive scripts for calibration, then CASA tclean mosaic imaging with MFS over the four SPWs, cleaned to 3 sigma
key_parameters: mosaic gridder, hogbom deconvolver, Briggs robust 0.5

recipe.method: 'fixed' method: standard deviation of the whole non-PB-corrected image after sigma clipping; compared with 'individual' sliding-box noise maps from SEP, AEGEAN, SoFiA
key_parameters: individual method: 100x100 pixel box, step of one pixel
only pixels with primary beam response above 50 percent

recipe.goal: extract sources and build the main and supplementary catalogues
recipe.method: SEP, AEGEAN and SoFiA run on the non-PB-corrected map at >4 sigma with the 'fixed' noise; plus independent visual inspection; 47 sources detected by all three codes form the main catalogue (categories A and B)
key_parameters: minarea = 5 contiguous pixels above 4 sigma (linker.minPixels = 5 in SoFiA)

recipe.method: p = (N_pos - N_neg)/N_pos per S/N bin, negative peaks found by running the same extraction on the sign-inverted map
peak flux on PB-corrected images; elliptical Gaussian fit; elliptical aperture photometry (2 x synthesized beam)
key_parameters: Gaussian fit on a cutout of 5 x major axis; amplitude, axial ratio and position angle free
Gaussian-fit flux uncertainty from 1000 iterations at random positions

recipe.goal: derive completeness and flux boosting by Monte Carlo injection
recipe.method: inject point-like artificial sources convolved with the synthesized beam into the PB-corrected image, convert to PB-uncorrected, re-run extraction and flux measurement, compare recovered to input
key_parameters: 20 sources per bin, normal random flux, random positions with PB response > 0.5 and separations of at least 1 arcsec
recovered if extracted within 1 arcsec of the injected position

recipe.goal: compute effective area and differential/cumulative number counts
recipe.method: each source contributes xi = p/(A_eff C); summed per flux bin for dN/dS and above S0 for N(>S); effective area from local noise (fixed noise divided by PB response)
key_parameters: uncertainties from 1000 resamplings of source fluxes with their measured flux and 1 sigma noise; median and 1 sigma dispersion adopted
Gaussian-fit fluxes used for the counts; aperture fluxes give consistent results

recipe.goal: quantify the DSFG overdensity relative to general fields
recipe.method: ratio of cumulative number counts in Spiderweb to literature general-field counts (ALMACAL, GOODS-ALMA) in five log flux bins 0.25-1.69 mJy; also simple surface densities above 0.23 mJy
key_parameters: 1.1 mm counts converted to 1.2 mm with factor 1.29
assumptions: ALESS average SED at z = 2.2 for the wavelength conversion

recipe.goal: compare spatial distributions of DSFGs, HAEs and CO emitters
recipe.method: 5th-neighbour density maps, per-field surface-density excess normalised by the footprint mean, cumulative distributions with distance to the Spiderweb galaxy, and 2D Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests
key_parameters: CO matching radius 2-6 arcsec scaled by ATCA beams; HAE matching radius 1 arcsec

recipe.goal: derive dust-based gas masses and compare with CO gas masses
recipe.method: gas mass from Rayleigh-Jeans dust luminosity (Gaussian-fit fluxes), compared with CO(1-0)-based masses for the 13 matched sources
key_parameters: alpha_CO 0.8 (starburst) and 3.6 (star-forming), also tested as single values for all sources
assumptions: dust temperature 25 K, beta = 2, gas-to-dust mass ratio 105 (as printed)

recipe.goal: derive SFRs, SFR densities and group properties
recipe.method: convert 1.2 mm fluxes to 850 um via ALESS SED, SFR from the Cowie et al. linear relation; SFR density for several assumed volumes; depletion time from SFR and dust-based gas mass
key_parameters: volumes: 120 cMpc line of sight over ~20 arcmin^2 (48 cMpc^2); 2 Mpc sphere; ~400 kpc sphere
assumptions: volume choice drives the SFR density

recipe.goal: compare ALMA with single-dish LABOCA/AzTEC detections
recipe.method: sum ALMA fluxes inside each single-dish beam, scale single-dish fluxes to 1.2 mm, and compute the ratio and multiplicity
assumptions: single-dish fluxes scaled to 1.2 mm with the same SED method as in Sec. 4.3

Channel ranges excluded around CO(7-6) and CI(2-1) and at SPW edges for the continuum
How the C2 and C4 execution blocks in Field 4 were combined in one tclean run (weighting/uv ranges)
Full SoFiA and AEGEAN configuration beyond the key parameters in Table 1; how the 2D noise maps were produced inside each code
Bin edges and bin centres used for the differential counts; how the flux-boosting correction was applied to the counts
Which alpha_CO (0.8 or 3.6) was assigned to each CO emitter and the CO luminosities themselves (from COALAS catalogue)

Public data status is not stated in the paper

score_reason: Project code, array configs, spectral setup, robust, tclean mode, noise method, source-finder parameters and the Monte Carlo recipe are given and the catalogue is tabulated, but the CASA version, clean masks/thresholds, channel selection and several literature inputs are missing.
rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state that the data are public, but Cycle 8 data from a named project code are likely out of the proprietary period; the recipe (continuum imaging, noise, extraction, Monte Carlo counts) is mostly complete and results are tabulated numerically.
